sourceFamilies.finding: Policy fileHashes serially reads pathname MAIN/WAL/SHM and compares content before/after copying/classification. Equal hashes do not independently bind private scientific bytes or same-byte inode replacement. Cache dataHashes intentionally excludes SHM; policy-copy equality separately uses all three.
